title: F09 — Markup and stamps
tagline: markup is a vector layer over the original photo; a stamped copy carries trusted time. The original is never touched.

series.name: SiteLog: an iOS app and its API, built

intro: Sprint S5 · 22h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: markup is a vector layer over the original photo; a stamped copy carries trusted time. The original is never touched.
  • Demo — offline: mark up a photo; the original hash is unchanged; share a stamped copy with “device time” confidence.
  • Demo — signed in: the markup appears on the second device; the stamp uses the server clock offset.
